# A framework for AMNOG style HTA analyses

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/hta-pharma/chef/actions/workflows/package-check-test.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hta-pharma/chef/actions/workflows/package-check-test.yaml)

# Purpose

To provide an open-source opinionated framework for setting up pipelines
for AMNOG-style HTA analyses in conjunction with the
{[ramnog](https://github.com/hta-pharma/ramnog)} package.

# Aim

The aim of {chef} is that a programmer has to write minimal code, and no
programming to in order to set-up a new AMNOG-type analyses. For each
study, the programmer will need to make, adjust, or check the following
four types of code:

1.  The definition of each endpoint (or group of endpoints).
2.  A set of adam functions that makes any modifications to existing
    ADaM datasets (e.g., new age grouping in ADSL), or makes new ADaM
    datasets if none exist for the required output.
3.  (If needed) Define a set of criteria for when an endpoint should be
    included in the results. A library of these criteria are stored in
    the companion package {chefCriteria}
4.  A specification of the statistical functions used to
    summarize/analyze the data.

Behind the scenes {chef} uses the
{[targets](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/)} package to handle the
pipelines.

For help and guidance on building an analysis pipeline, see the
{[ramnog](https://hta-pharma.github.io/ramnog/)} package.

# Developer Documentation

Please refer to {ramnog} for general [developer
documentation](https://hta-pharma.github.io/ramnog/articles/#:~:text=Debugging-,Development,-Git%20Workflow).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_event_index()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/add_event_index.md)
  : Add Event Index to Expanded Endpoints
- [`add_forced_group_levels()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/add_forced_group_levels.md)
  : Add forced group levels
- [`add_id()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/add_id.md) :
  Add ID to user-defined endpoint groups
- [`apply_criterion_by_strata()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/apply_criterion_by_strata.md)
  : Apply criterion by strata
- [`apply_criterion_endpoint()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/apply_criterion_endpoint.md)
  : Apply Endpoint Criterion
- [`apply_dt_filter()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/apply_dt_filter.md)
  : Apply filtering logic to a data.table
- [`apply_stats()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/apply_stats.md)
  : Apply Statistical Methods
- [`check_duplicate_functions()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/check_duplicate_functions.md)
  : Check for duplicate function definitions
- [`define_expanded_ep()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/define_expanded_ep.md)
  : Define Expanded Endpoint Specifications
- [`define_expansion_cell_from_data()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/define_expansion_cell_from_data.md)
  : Create Expansion Cell Containing a Data Table Based on Strata
- [`evaluate_criteria()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/evaluate_criteria.md)
  : Evaluate criteria for inclusion of endpoints or endpoint strata
- [`expand_ep_for_stats()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/expand_ep_for_stats.md)
  : Expand Endpoint Data for Statistics
- [`expand_over_endpoints()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/expand_over_endpoints.md)
  : Expand endpoint definitions
- [`fetch_db_data()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/fetch_db_data.md)
  : Fetch ADaM tables from a source based on endpoint specifications
- [`filter_adam_db()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/filter_adam_db.md)
  : Title
- [`filter_db_data()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/filter_db_data.md)
  : Filter study data based on endpoint specifications
- [`generate_function_table_row()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/generate_function_table_row.md)
  : Generate a row for the function table
- [`group_ep_for_targets()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/group_ep_for_targets.md)
  : Group endpoints for targets pipeline
- [`index_expanded_ep_groups()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/index_expanded_ep_groups.md)
  : Index the expanded endpoints
- [`index_non_null_group_level()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/index_non_null_group_level.md)
  : Index Non-Null Group Levels
- [`llist()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/llist.md) :
  Make list of lists
- [`load_debug_session()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/load_debug_session.md)
  : Load Debugging Session
- [`mk_endpoint_str()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/mk_endpoint_str.md)
  : Make an endpoint specification record
- [`mk_userdef_fn_dt()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/mk_userdef_fn_dt.md)
  : Parse functions supplied by user
- [`parse_function_input()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/parse_function_input.md)
  : Parse function inputs
- [`prepare_for_stats()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/prepare_for_stats.md)
  : Prepare (and Expand) Endpoint for Statistical Analysis
- [`run_pipeline()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/run_pipeline.md)
  : Run a targets pipeline
- [`stage_pipeline()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/stage_pipeline.md)
  : Stage a targets pipeline so that you can work interactively with it
- [`try_and_validate()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/try_and_validate.md)
  : Try and Validate Wrapper for Statistical Functions
- [`unnest_by_fns()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/unnest_by_fns.md)
  : Unnest data model by the supplied function columns
- [`unnest_endpoint_functions()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/unnest_endpoint_functions.md)
  : Unnest over user-supplied functions in endpoint definitions
- [`use_chef()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/use_chef.md)
  : Build a pipeline from a template
- [`validate_crit_output()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/validate_crit_output.md)
  : Validate Output from Criterion Functions
- [`validate_endpoints_def()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/validate_endpoints_def.md)
  : Validate user inputs to endpoint definition
- [`validate_stat_output()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/validate_stat_output.md)
  : Validate Output from Statistical Functions
- [`validate_usr_fn_args()`](https://hta-pharma.github.io/chef/reference/validate_usr_fn_args.md)
  : Validate the user supplied functions arguments.
